project.name: flight-pulse
project.objective: Use Genesis as the shared task, evidence, governance, and checkpoint layer for maintaining and evolving Flight Pulse without changing its existing application behavior or replacing its current project documentation.

lifecycle.next_action: Review completed work and choose the next bounded outcome.

invariants.text: Genesis supplements the existing Flight Pulse documentation and governance; it does not replace them.
No live external API call, paid service, new dependency, or destructive operation may be performed without explicit human approval.
Credentials and secrets must never be committed, logged, displayed, or included in agent evidence.
No agent may merge changes into main without explicit human approval.

decisions.title: Native MA-001 orchestration model
decisions.text: Use the root Codex session as Master / Orchestrator and sole Genesis state writer. Register six native specialist roles in .codex/config.toml with bounded TOML instructions under .codex/agents. Cap agent depth at one; reviewer agents report findings and the Master delegates accepted fixes to the Implementation Agent.

decisions.title: MA-001 specialist review triage
decisions.text: Accepted Security's defense-in-depth recommendation and set approval_policy=never for Code Review and Security agents. Rejected the claimed Python runtime mismatch after reproducing the Genesis child process environment: conda run -n flight-pulse resolves python to /opt/anaconda3/envs/flight-pulse/bin/python, Python 3.11.17, with CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV=flight-pulse. Code Review reported no findings; Test reported no additional automated tests needed.

decisions.title: FP-001 median departure-delay design
decisions.text: Compute median departure delay inside the existing read-only OVERVIEW_SQL using MySQL window functions over non-null departure_delay_minutes. Preserve the existing departure_delay_samples key, expose the new value through the unchanged overview/report path, display it as a current-sample metric, and return null when no observations exist. Validate odd/even/null behavior locally without new dependencies or external calls.

decisions.title: FP-002 reserved alias fix
decisions.text: Local MySQL INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEYWORDS classified ROW_NUMBER as reserved (RESERVED=1). Preserve the ROW_NUMBER() window function but rename its derived-column alias and reference from row_number to delay_rank. Keep SQLite tests limited to median semantics and require separate execution of the exact production OVERVIEW_SQL on local MySQL for dialect validation.

decisions.title: Defer DOC-001 terminal reconciliation
decisions.text: DOC-001 was approved, shipped, and merged in PR #18, but Genesis completion refuses because the immutable original task scope omitted the later human-approved .gitattributes file. Do not hand-edit generated task state or erase the audit trail. Requeue DOC-001 and activate the already-declared UI-001; reconcile DOC-001 terminal state separately if Genesis gains a supported scope-correction path.
decisions.source: Genesis task complete scope enforcement after PR #18

knowledge.title: UI-001 implementation, render, test, and review evidence
knowledge.text: Implementation changed only render_business_overview and render_technical_overview in app.py. Test Agent ran the complete local suite in the flight-pulse Python 3.11 Conda environment: 63 tests passed with no live provider calls. Streamlit AppTest executed the real app with zero exceptions and rendered exactly Flight Analytics, Business Overview, and Technical Overview; displayed metrics included median departure delay 21.00 min and Automated tests 63. Flight Analytics, analytics/SQL/ingestion/schema/Gemini/dependency/external-service behavior were unchanged. Independent Code Review reported no actionable findings. Direct git diff --check passed. The first Genesis test-gate attempt used base Python 3.13 and failed because google.genai was unavailable there; the preserved retry under the documented flight-pulse Conda environment passed both executable gates.
